_doc: Approved URL-pruning patterns consumed by build-plugins/shared/trafficEvidenceFilter.ts. URL with traffic in any source (data/evidence-index.json GSC topLandingPage / GA4 sessions >=3 / PostHog pageviews + data/indexed-cluster-urls.json + data/gsc-job-urls.json + data/gsc-orphan-job-slugs.json + data/orphan-enriched-data.json + data/thin-page-promotions-active.json) stays 'full'; URL not in any set and matching a pattern here gets the pattern's action AFTER the minAgeDays grace window expires (checked against data/url-first-seen.json).
